issues.claim: `AddOrUpdate` makes the whole operation atomic ... (RU: «AddOrUpdate делает всю операцию атомарной»); answer: "The fix is the atomic call `counts.AddOrUpdate(...)`"
issues.problem: The cited Learn page says that although all ConcurrentDictionary methods are thread-safe, not all are atomic, "specifically GetOrAdd and AddOrUpdate". The explanation itself later says the delegate runs outside the lock and may run more than once. Calling AddOrUpdate atomic therefore contradicts the source and the explanation, and a candidate would learn the wrong terminology. What is true is that the update is applied with compare-and-retry, so no increment is lost, and the delegate can be invoked several times.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace "atomic" for AddOrUpdate in both locales (answer and explanation), for example: "AddOrUpdate does the read-compute-store as a compare-and-retry loop: it stores the new value only if the current value is still the one it read, otherwise it recomputes. No increment is lost. The method is thread-safe but not atomic in the docs' sense: the update delegate runs outside the lock and may run more than once, so it must be fast and free of side effects." Apply the same change to the RU text.
